# Immutable pre-PR59 schema fixtures

These empty schema dumps were generated by executing `init_core_v1` and
`init_db` from the actual Git object `11c69f6`. They are not derived from the
current schema and must never be recreated by subtracting columns from current
DDL.

Generation used an isolated `git archive 11c69f6 src/ocbrain` extraction with
that extraction first on `PYTHONPATH`, then called each initializer and emitted
`sqlite3.Connection.iterdump()`. The generator asserted that the four PR59
columns were absent. It also asserted that the strict-v1 database contained
`schema_meta.core_schema = ocbrain.core.v1` before dumping.

The committed SHA-256 digests are pinned in `test_closeout_discipline.py`:

- SHA-256 `strict-v1.sql`: `b0524c49f1240c048c59d947f6878975ba5c89ed58c869ea7e4b176135eb9ea1`
- SHA-256 `v0.sql`: `3951998b422a0eb9e3ac62124d97eac3de0c19078c2127d7e146ce92b3e56f79`

Any intentional fixture replacement must execute the pinned base revision
again and update both the provenance note and digest assertion.
